title: Against the Current
description: Shen Jialan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jinqi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jinqi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

title: Tiovivo c. 1950
description: Madrid, the capital of Spain in the 50s, it is still in a latent postwar period. A carousel of several survivors try to make a living in a gloomy country.

description: Zhou Zi Shu gets embroiled in a conspiracy in the martial arts world. He meets Wen Ke Xing who leaves the Ghost Valley to avenge his parents' deaths. They become fast friends and embark on an adventure to find a legendary treasure.

title: You Are Desire [Hindi]
description: After her parents' divorce, Lin Yujing moves to a new city and becomes seatmates with Shen Juan, a withdrawn student repeating a year. As they grow closer, her presence begins to change his life. Just as things start to improve, she’s forced to return to her hometown. A year later, they reunite at university, where Lin Yujing helps Shen Juan confront his past and heal, while also discovering her own path in life.

title: My Stepbrother by Day, My Forbidden Lover by Night

Lily vows to stay away to protect her mother’s hard-won happiness, but Ryder refuses to pretend they are family.

title: When C Goes with G7
description: When a heartbroken film school graduate, an unemployed UC Berkeley MBA graduate and a junior high school student converge at the music instruments store of an aspiring musician, quirky thoughts on everything from work and education to love and life emerge against a truly catchy soundtrack. Relationships end and hopes are occasionally dashed in this episodic drama, but few could complain that this isn't a thoughtful attempt to capture the sentiments of growing up in Hong Kong as we know it today.

title: M A N C A V E
C-38: The Search for Marriage
description: On June 22nd, 2005, Bill C-38 passed a final reading in the House of Commons, making Canada the fourth country in history to officially sanction same-sex marriages. Some saw it as the final hurdle in a 40-year marathon for equality. To others, it undermined an age-old building block of society. This controversial legislation continues to divide the country, and indeed the world, in half. Through interviews with the public as well as experts in various fields, 'C-38: The Search for Marriage' challenges common notions about marriage, sexuality and equality to answer these and other fundamental questions from an equal and fair perspective.

title: Stellar Transformation S1-S6

title: Who Stole My AC in 40°C Heat?
description: Marco, an appliance dealer who rose from the bottom, returned to his old apartment building and paid out of his own pocket to install air conditioners for every household, as a way of repaying the kindness he had received years ago. However, his neighbor Marina took the lead in filing claims under various pretexts and engaging in moral blackmail. Without arguing, Marco dismantled all the air conditioners overnight and took them away. When the scorching heat arrived, the old building suffered terribly, while the new building across the street remained cool and orderly. After enduring heatstroke, shortages, and failed extortion attempts, the neighbors finally broke down and had no choice but to turn to Marco for help. Marco presented them with a business contract and insisted that things be done according to the rules. In the end, the neighbors paid to have the units reinstalled—except for Anna, the only one who had stayed clear-headed back then, and who received Marco's free, special care.

title: 96°C Café
description: 96°C Café is set against the backdrop of a homely café, owned by married couple Liqiao (Desmond Tan) and Xijie (Paige Chua). When Xijie meets with an accident, she stops working at the café and things start to change. As Xijie becomes more forlorn and withdrawn, Liqiao over time develops an unlikely affinity with Yuchen (Julie Tan), a fine arts student hired to help out in the café. With an unexpected twist at the end of the mini drama, this is a contemporary love story which brings cheers and tugs at the heartstrings of viewers.

description: Daniel C. Dennett is the most influential contemporary philosopher of the mind and a great reformer in the field of knowledge. title: CEO's Cute Charm For Love
description: Song Yujia and Lu Huanyu's new drama begins with a special marriage. In the marriage, the man went abroad with a third party, and the two lived based on an agreement not to interfere with each other. The heroine Xu Wenyan chose to support a gigolo in response. Two years later, when her husband, who was married in disguise, returned to China, it foreshadowed the resurgence of this complicated relationship - Xu Wenyan's relationship with the gigolo came to an end. At the same time, the prince of the Beijing circle, who had been silently supporting the heroine, decided not to hide his true feelings and identity anymore, and strived to spend the rest of his life with the heroine as a formal partner, starting a battle for love and identity.

title: Fini le Lèche-Bottes, Vive la Richesse ( Doublé )
description: Pendant 3 ans, Loïc Gaillard court après Rosa Lecomte, la star de la fac, qui finit par le larguer sans pitié. Dans sa détresse, il active un « système de larbin ». Mais Loïc, qui en a assez de ramper, décide d'exploiter un bug du système pour empocher d'énormes sommes d'argent, et pour s'acheter tout ce qu'il désire. Convaincu que ce choix égoïste le condamnera à finir seul, il finit par comprendre : quand on investit en soi, les beautés se pressent naturellement !

title: Till I See You
description: Song Yi, a wealthy young man raised in Japan, travels to Northern China in search of answers about his father's past and unexpectedly becomes Xu Feiyu's temporary caregiver. Recovering from eye surgery with his eyes still covered in bandages, Feiyu slowly lowers his guard under Song Yi's domineering yet tender care. Before they can truly "see" each other, they have already fallen in love.

title: Salad Days
description: "Salad Days: A Decade of Punk in Washington, DC (1980-90)" examines the early DIY punk scene in the Nation's Capital. It was a decade when seminal bands like Bad Brains, Minor Threat, Government Issue, Scream, Void, Faith, Rites of Spring, Marginal Man, Fugazi, and others released their own records and booked their own shows-without major record label constraints or mainstream media scrutiny. Contextually, it was a cultural watershed that predated the alternative music explosion of the 1990s (and the industry's subsequent implosion). Thirty years later, DC's original DIY punk spirit serves as a reminder of the hopefulness of youth, the power of community and the strength of conviction.

title: Mudhal Kanave
description: The movie begins in Kanyakumari where Hari (Vikranth) settles down as painter for his livelihood. He comes across Jennifer (Honey Rose) and gets attracted by her. A sequence of events reveals that she is a married woman. She is the wife of David (Yugendhran) in the same village. Hari opens his heart to his employer (Manivann). A flashback reveals that Hari and Jennifer had been in love for a long time. A sequence of events leaves Jennifer mistaking Hari for no fault of him. She gets married and settles down in Kaniyakumari. Hari is hopeful that he would woo back Jennifer. The rest of the event is all but how Jennifer and Hari get united.

title: Echoes of a Daydream

title: [Doublé] Le Dragon Furtif Est De Retour
description: Quentin Fèvre, le Roi des Mercenaires, est las des conflits. Un simple contrôle de sécurité révèle son identité stupéfiante. Alors qu'un contrat de mariage est prévu avec Céline Seguin, héritière de la famille Seguin, Quentin découvre que la jeune femme est entourée de dangers. Il utilise ses propres méthodes pour aider Céleste Seguin, mais se retrouve entraîné malgré lui dans une conspiration bien plus vaste. Face à chaque piège, Quentin Fèvre riposte, surmonte les périls et parvient à se sortir de situations difficiles.

description: Laurel York has been secretly loving Sean Leon since childhood but never dared to approach him due to her insecurities about her appearance. Fortunately, the two ultimately overcame the obstacles and misunderstandings, finding happiness together.

title: Caché Derrière Les Roses ( Doublé )
description: Pour jauger sa fiancée Zoé, le milliardaire Maël se glisse à la fac en se faisant passer pour un étudiant défavorisé. Zoé le désigne comme cobaye d'un jeu. Elle simule une cour assidue, ayant parié avec ses complices qu'elle l'abandonnerait en un mois. Maël entre dans la danse tout en contrôlant chaque mouvement en coulisses, et ceux qui se croyaient prédateurs deviennent des proies. Devastated and furious, Elara impulsively marries Charlie Shaw, a man trapped in a vegetative state.

title: [Doublé] Il ne reste plus toi dans ma vie
description:
Sophie, véritable dirigeante du Groupe Célestia, avait renoncé à son rôle au sommet de l’entreprise afin de soutenir son mari Alex. Elle s’était volontairement retirée pour devenir femme au foyer, et avait consacré sept années entières à prendre soin de sa famille. Elle avait même veillé sur Alex lorsqu’il avait été gravement malade, l’ayant accompagné sans relâche jusqu’à sa guérison, en y mettant toute son énergie et toute sa tendresse.



Cependant, cet amour qu’elle avait donné sans compter s’était transformé en une trahison totale. Le jour même de la cérémonie des cent jours de leur fils Léo, Alex a ramené sa maîtresse Emma ainsi que son fils illégitime Félix. Sous la complaisance de ses parents, Alex a imposé à Sophie un choix injuste : soit accepter la cohabitation avec Emma et Félix et continuer à servir la famille Bernard, soit divorcer sans pouvoir emmener son enfant.
